none: PAS FindID 1015463: Roman coin fragment: nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right, Reece period 19. Worn, with chips on either side of flan. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive [and holding labarum]. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 14.4mm, Weight: 0.58gms, die axis: 12
